leadText:
Pokémon the Movie 2000 - The Power of One is the English score to the second Pokémon movie, The Power of One.

It was released on its own in Germany and Brazil. In , it was available in a 2-disc bundle pack with Pokémon 3: The Ultimate Soundtrack.

It was released on the iTunes Store in 2004 by , but it was removed from the store in most countries following iTunes' move to .
